data.title: Link
data.tagline: Click to open another page, location, or file
data.description: A link takes people to another page, a place on the same page, or a downloadable file. Its text should make the destination clear, and keyboard users need a visible focus state. Use a Button for actions such as saving or submitting.

use: Jump to a section on the current page
Open documentation or a referenced source
avoid: Use a link to submit, save, or delete data
Write only “click here” without naming the destination
Style it like plain text so people miss it
Open a new tab without a reason or a visible hint

lessonPractice.title: Clicking an order number should open its own detail page with a copyable URL and browser Back support. What fits best?

options.label: Make the order number a link to the detail URL
options.feedback: A link provides a real destination plus URL copying, browser history, and keyboard access.

options.label: Use a button to expand details below the current list
options.feedback: A button can reveal content, but it does not provide the independent, copyable destination requested.

options.label: Attach a click handler to plain text and replace the page content
options.feedback: Plain clickable text lacks link semantics and can lose URL, focus, and browser navigation behavior.

data.agentPrompt: Turn each order number into a link to its detail URL instead of attaching a click handler to plain text. Verify keyboard focus, URL copying, and browser Back returning to the order list.
